import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianCandidateSupport

/-!
# Finite support from generic vanishing on curve fibres

A finitely presented module on a proper smooth geometrically integral relative
curve has finite schematic support over the base when its restriction to each
fibre vanishes at the generic point. This assembles the fibrewise support
criterion needed for the quotient reconstructed from the Grassmannian.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

/-- Finiteness of the support of the fibre module gives finiteness of the
corresponding set-theoretic fibre of the schematic-support morphism. -/
theorem finite_fiber_schematicSupport_of_finite_fiberModule_support
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] (t : S)
    (hfinite : ((annihilator (p.fiberModule t F)).support : Set (p.fiber t)).Finite) :
    ((schematicSupportι F ≫ p) ⁻¹' {t}).Finite := by
  let C := p.fiber t
  let Ft : C.Modules := (pullback (p.fiberι t)).obj F
  let s : Set (schematicSupport F) := (schematicSupportι F ≫ p) ⁻¹' {t}
  let liftToFiber : s → C := fun z =>
    (p.fiberHomeo t).symm ⟨schematicSupportι F z.1, by
      change p (schematicSupportι F z.1) = t
      exact z.2⟩
  have hlift_mem (z : s) : liftToFiber z ∈ (annihilator Ft).support := by
    rw [show (annihilator Ft).support =
      (annihilator F).support.preimage (p.fiberι t).continuous by
        simpa [Ft] using annihilator_pullback_support_eq_preimage (p.fiberι t) F]
    change p.fiberι t (liftToFiber z) ∈ (annihilator F).support
    have hmem : schematicSupportι F z.1 ∈ (annihilator F).support :=
      (Set.ext_iff.mp (annihilator F).range_subschemeι
        (schematicSupportι F z.1)).mp ⟨z.1, rfl⟩
    simpa [liftToFiber] using hmem
  let lift : s → (annihilator Ft).support :=
    fun z => ⟨liftToFiber z, hlift_mem z⟩
  have hlift_inj : Function.Injective lift := by
    intro z₁ z₂ h
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hfiber : liftToFiber z₁ = liftToFiber z₂ := congrArg Subtype.val h
    have hamb := congrArg (fun c : C => p.fiberι t c) hfiber
    apply (isPreimmersion_schematicSupportι F).isEmbedding.injective
    simpa [liftToFiber] using hamb
  letI : Fintype (annihilator Ft).support := hfinite.fintype
  letI : Finite s := Finite.of_injective lift hlift_inj
  exact Set.finite_coe_iff.mp inferInstance

/-- Generic vanishing on the fibres of a smooth proper geometrically integral
relative curve makes every fibre of the schematic support finite. -/
theorem finite_fiber_schematicSupport_of_genericPoint_avoidance
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ S)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 p] [GeometricallyIntegral p] [IsProper p]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (t : S)
    (hgeneric : genericPoint (p.fiber t) ∉
      (annihilator (p.fiberModule t F)).support) :
    ((schematicSupportι F ≫ p) ⁻¹' {t}).Finite := by
  letI : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (@SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1) :=
    smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange 1
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t) :=
    MorphismProperty.pullback_snd _ _ (inferInstance : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 p)
  haveI : IsProper (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t) :=
    MorphismProperty.pullback_snd _ _ (inferInstance : IsProper p)
  have hfp : (p.fiberModule t F).IsFinitePresentation :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation (p.fiberι t) F inferInstance
  exact finite_fiber_schematicSupport_of_finite_fiberModule_support p F t
    (@finite_annihilator_support_of_genericPoint_avoidance
      (S.residueField t) inferInstance (Over.mk (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t))
      (inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t)))
      (inferInstanceAs (IsIntegral (p.fiber t)))
      (inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t)))
      (inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t)))
      (p.fiberModule t F) hfp hgeneric)

/-- A finitely presented module on a proper smooth geometrically integral
relative curve has finite schematic support if every fibre avoids its generic
point. -/
theorem isFinite_schematicSupport_of_fiber_genericPoint_avoidance
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ S)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 p] [GeometricallyIntegral p] [IsProper p]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hgeneric : ∀ t : S, genericPoint (p.fiber t) ∉
      (annihilator (p.fiberModule t F)).support) :
    IsFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ p) := by
  have hps : HasProperSupport p F := by
    change IsProper ((annihilator F).subschemeι ≫ p)
    infer_instance
  haveI : IsProper (schematicSupportι F ≫ p) := hps
  haveI : LocallyQuasiFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ p) :=
    locallyQuasiFinite_schematicSupportι_comp_of_finite_fibers p F hps
      (fun t => finite_fiber_schematicSupport_of_genericPoint_avoidance p F t (hgeneric t))
  exact IsFinite.of_isProper_of_locallyQuasiFinite _

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
